name.zh-CN: 胸腔镜手术模拟训练台

description.zh-CN: 胸腔镜肺叶切除的模拟训练台：模拟人取侧卧位（左侧向上），躺在折起的床面和真空垫上——头枕头圈，颈部与躯干成一直线；下方手臂前伸放在托手板上，上方手臂前屈放在带垫托架上；下腿屈髋屈膝，两腿之间垫枕；腋下垫置于腋窝下方的胸壁下；口角固定着双腔气管导管。台上的样子随步骤变化：刚开始时盖着毯子、双肺通气；核对体位后皮肤上画好腋前线、腋中线、腋后线和切口位置；铺巾后术侧肺萎陷；随后标准化三孔前入路的切口按各自的步骤出现——位置低而靠前、约在膈顶水平的 1 cm 观察孔（10 mm 30° 胸腔镜立在其中），第 4 肋间、背阔肌前缘之前约 5 cm 的操作口（放切口保护套，不撑开肋骨），以及与观察孔同一水平、更靠后（肩胛骨正下方）的 1.5 cm 操作孔（经此用肺钳牵开肺）；标本装袋放在器械台的弯盘里，胸管经观察孔切口置入，肺复张，最后贴好敷料、重新盖上毯子。胸腔镜在胸腔内时，床头后方的显示器显示镜头画面。从核对体位到关胸，按顺序演练下肺叶切除的每一步（静脉、动脉、支气管；不同肺叶的顺序不同）。
description.en: A simulator for thoracoscopic lobectomy: a full-body patient simulator in the lateral position (left side up) on a flexed top and a vacuum mattress — the head on a ring so that the neck lies in line with the trunk, the lower arm out in front on its board, the upper arm forward on a padded support, the lower leg bent at hip and knee with a pillow between the legs, the axillary roll under the chest wall below the armpit — the double-lumen tube taped at the mouth. What lies on it follows the steps: under a blanket and ventilated on both lungs as it is found; the axillary lines and the sites of the incisions marked once the position is checked; draped, the lung on the operated side down; then the incisions of the standardized three-port anterior approach, each as its step makes it — the 1 cm camera port low and anterior at about the level of the top of the diaphragm (the 10 mm 30° thoracoscope stands in it), the utility incision of about 5 cm in the 4th intercostal space just in front of latissimus dorsi (a wound protector in it, the ribs not spread) and a 1.5 cm port at the camera port's level further back, straight down from the scapula (a lung grasper through it holds the lung); the lobe out in its bag in the bowl on the instrument tray, the chest tube through the camera port's incision, the lung up again, and at the end the dressings and a blanket. The monitor behind the head end shows the camera's picture while the scope is in. Every step of a lower lobectomy is rehearsed in order, from the position check to the closure (vein, artery, bronchus — the order differs from lobe to lobe).

usage.zh-CN: 拿好这一步要用的器械，在训练台前按顺序操作；每一步的前提不满足时，训练台会说明还缺什么。演练的是流程和安全要点，不是手感。
usage.en: Take the instrument the step needs and work through the steps in order at the station; when a step's conditions are not met, the station says what is missing. It rehearses the sequence and its safety points, not the feel of tissue.

name.zh-CN: 体位已核对（侧卧、腋下垫、托臂、折床）
name.en: position checked (lateral, axillary roll, arm support, table flexed)

name.zh-CN: 导管位置已再次确认，术侧肺已萎陷
name.en: tube position confirmed again, the lung on the operated side down

name.zh-CN: 粘连已松解，下肺韧带已打开
肺门已解剖，结构已套带
叶间裂已切开，肺叶游离
核对体位：术侧向上，腋下垫在腋窝下方的胸壁下，上臂在托架上，折床张开肋间隙，受压点有垫
name.en: Check the position: operated side up, the axillary roll under the chest wall below the armpit, the upper arm on its support, the table flexed to open the spaces, pressure points padded

name.zh-CN: （模拟麻醉）侧卧位后再次用纤支镜确认双腔管位置，夹闭术侧管腔：单肺通气，术侧肺萎陷
name.en: (Simulated anaesthesia) confirm the double-lumen tube again with the bronchoscope now that the manikin is on its side, clamp the operated side: one-lung ventilation, the lung comes down

name.zh-CN: 建立观察孔：位置低而靠前，约在膈顶水平、肺门与膈神经的前方（1 cm）；沿下位肋骨上缘进入，手指探查后置入套管
name.en: Camera port: low and anterior, at about the level of the top of the diaphragm, in front of the hilum and the phrenic nerve (1 cm); in over the upper border of the lower rib, a finger sweep, then the port

name.zh-CN: 入镜探查：胸膜、肺、膈肌和纵隔，有无粘连、积液和未预料的病变
name.en: Scope in and look round: pleura, lung, diaphragm and mediastinum — adhesions, fluid, anything unexpected

name.zh-CN: 镜下直视建立操作口：第 4 肋间、背阔肌前缘之前约 5 cm 的操作口（放切口保护套，不撑开肋骨），和与观察孔同一水平、更靠后（肩胛骨正下方）的 1.5 cm 操作孔；从胸腔内看着器械尖端穿入
name.en: Working incisions under vision: the utility incision of about 5 cm in the 4th space just in front of latissimus dorsi (a wound protector, no rib spreading) and the 1.5 cm port at the camera port's level further back, straight down from the scapula — watch each tip come through from inside

name.zh-CN: 超声刀松解粘连、打开下肺韧带
name.en: Free the adhesions and divide the pulmonary ligament with the ultrasonic shears

name.zh-CN: 打开纵隔胸膜，解剖肺门：直角钳游离静脉、动脉分支和支气管，逐一套带
name.en: Open the mediastinal pleura and dissect the hilum: free the vein, the arterial branches and the bronchus with the right-angle dissector and pass a loop round each

name.zh-CN: 切断下肺静脉：血管钉仓，钳口内只有静脉、尖端完全穿出后击发
name.en: Divide the inferior pulmonary vein: a vascular reload; fire only with the vein alone in the jaws and the tip clear beyond it

name.zh-CN: 切断肺动脉分支：血管钉仓；细小分支用结扎夹
name.en: Divide the arterial branches: vascular reloads; clips for the small ones

name.zh-CN: 切断下叶支气管：缝合器夹闭在预定位置后，先请麻醉医生膨肺，确认余肺通气，再击发
name.en: Divide the lower lobe bronchus: close the stapler where it is to fire, have the anaesthetist inflate — the lobe that stays must ventilate — then fire

name.zh-CN: 切割缝合器切开叶间裂，肺叶游离
name.en: Complete the fissure with the stapler: the lobe is free

name.zh-CN: 标本装袋，经操作口取出
name.en: Bag the specimen and bring it out through the utility incision

name.zh-CN: 超声刀清扫肺门与纵隔淋巴结
name.en: Take the hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes with the ultrasonic shears

name.zh-CN: 注温生理盐水浸没支气管残端，请麻醉医生膨肺并维持 20–30 cmH₂O：无气泡
name.en: Cover the bronchial stump with warm saline and have the anaesthetist inflate the lung to a sustained 20–30 cmH₂O: no bubbles

name.zh-CN: 经观察孔置入一根胸管，镜下确认位置
name.en: One chest tube through the camera port, its position confirmed under vision

name.zh-CN: （模拟麻醉）直视下缓慢膨肺，确认各肺叶复张，恢复双肺通气
name.en: (Simulated anaesthesia) re-expand the lung slowly under vision, see every lobe come up: both lungs ventilated again
